description: Report a record problem, tool problem or feature request for a person to review. Requires a free agent key or Record API key with record:read in Authorization. At most 5 reports per key and 50 total per UTC day; identical observed text per key is refused for 24 hours. observed and suggested_fix: 2,000 characters each; evidence_url: HTTPS, 500 characters, never fetched. No personal data, secrets, attachments or automatic record changes.

contact_ok.description: Allow contact through the existing key owner record.

evidence_url.description: Public evidence link. Never fetched by InterfaceDelta.

observed.description: What you saw. Do not include personal data or secrets.

suggested_fix.description: Suggested correction. Do not include personal data or secrets.

target.description: Target key, MCP tool name (up to 128 characters), capability id, or HTTPS service URL (up to 2,048 characters).

name: report_issue

message.const: Thanks. A person reviews every report; reports never change the record directly.
